title: cystopteris fragilis f. dickeana
intro: Cystopteris fragilis f. dickeana, commonly known as the Dicke's brittle fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris fragilis f. dickeana include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against bacterial and fungal infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
